headline: Dense urban district with four metro stations and high housing prices

tags.reason: The district hosts 2.05 universities per 10k residents compared to the Baku median of 0.9.
Transport connectivity scores 81 points, supported by 4 metro stations and 9.6 bus stops per 10k residents (median 6.22).
Secondary apartment prices reach 2,558 AZN/m² against the median of 2,084 AZN/m², keeping affordability at 13.

summary: Yasamal records a population density of 9,735 people per km², which is substantially higher than the city median of 2,890.5. Public transport is a major asset with a transport index of 81, supported by 4 metro stations and 50 bus routes. Secondary flat prices stand at 2,558 AZN/m² against the 2,084 AZN/m² median, with 86% of 16,650 analysed listings possessing a title extract (çıxarış). Paved roads account for 93.3% of classified streets, though 47.6% of road surfaces remain unrecorded in the dataset.
strengths: High density of inpatient medical facilities (4.11 hospitals per 10k residents; Baku median 2.75)
Strong public transport network including four metro stations (transport index 81; Baku median 55.5)
Significant concentration of higher education institutions (2.05 universities per 10k residents; Baku median 0.9)
weaknesses: Low affordability for residential property purchases (affordability index 13; Baku median 50)
Limited provision of pre-school institutions per capita (0.56 kindergartens per 10k residents; Baku median 2.32)
Below-median grocery shop presence relative to population (9.35 groceries per 10k residents; Baku median 13.41)
best_for: University students and staff requiring walking access to campuses (40 universities in total)
Commuters relying on rapid transit via 4 metro stations and 187 bus stops
Buyers seeking registered properties with title deeds (86% deed share across 16,650 listings)
watch_out: Surface condition data is missing for 47.6% of the road network
Land valuation of 42,000 AZN per sot is a mock demo figure and must not be used for investment analysis
Preschool education options are restricted with only 0.56 kindergartens per 10k residents
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap data coverage is high, but 47.6% of road surface types are not mapped, and land plot prices are mock demo values rather than verified market transactions.
